youtube.title: Pyaaz kaatne par aansu kyun aate hain? 🧅 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Jab aap pyaaz kaatte ho, to wo ek chemical hathiyaar se wapas ladta hai. Zameen ke andar pyaaz jaanwaron ke liye ek tasty snack hai, isliye usne apni hifazat ka tareeka banaya.

Pyaaz ke cells ke andar chemicals alag-alag rakhe hote hain. Kaatne se cells toot jaate hain, chemicals mil kar gas banate hain, aur wo gas aapki aankhon ke nerves ko irritate karti hai. Tab aankhein aansu bahakar use dhone ki koshish karti hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
